purpose: Mac-local assistance; not a replacement roadmap or authority to change acceptance.

requests.title: Establish the local Mac helper and actual 15-minute schedule
requests.desiredOutcome: One reusable Mac-local Codex task polls this file every 15 minutes and returns evidence on the result branch.
authorizedScope: Inspect local context and existing helpers.
Create a project-local workspace and feed registry.
Create or reuse the native 15-minute same-task schedule with GPT-6 Astra.
Write only coordination registration/results on the dedicated result branch.
acceptance: Actual local macOS host and model verified.
Native schedule ID, interval, enabled state and next run read back.
One initial queue check completed without duplicating work.
Registration and this result are publicly readable without secrets or private paths.

requests.title: Connect Tanduna on Lucas's Mac and verify scoped access
requests.desiredOutcome: The Mac helper has working authorized Tanduna tools and can read the Renewal Engine project.
authorizedScope: If needed, inspect current official Tanduna setup and guide Lucas through local/browser login on this Mac.
Make read-only identity/project/task-plan capability checks. No account replacement or credential transfer.
acceptance: Working tool names and read-only project identity recorded.
Missing login/capability is reported as NEEDS_LUCAS or FAILED, never a successful connection.

requests.title: Prepare and review the native 218-task Tanduna plan
requests.desiredOutcome: A supported native draft/review accurately represents the canonical long-term plan; publication follows only exact owner poll approval.
authorizedScope: Refresh live project, existing tasks, drafts and proposals.
Adapt the reviewed export to the actual native tool schema without editing Tanduna's app.
Prepare/save the scoped draft and submit for textual review.
Present the exact reviewed proposal/hash/poll option to Lucas.
After Lucas explicitly approves that option, perform the supported publication and public readback.
acceptance: 26 waves and 218 tasks preserved: 50 for 0.1, 72 later 0.x, 80 long-term, 16 exploratory.
All twelve historical native IDs, contracts and dependencies remain traceable.
Real 0.1 release access, current evidence and remaining human gate are accurately represented.
Actual draft/proposal/review IDs and exact approval requirement returned.
Only after specific approval: public waves/counts/dependency/status/access readback and returned native IDs; otherwise WAITING_REVIEW/NEEDS_LUCAS.

requests.title: Facilitate the human maintainer walkthrough on the Mac
requests.desiredOutcome: Lucas or another consenting qualified human supplies actual public-release review observations; agent checks remain separately labeled.
authorizedScope: Download the released artifact and verify its digest.
Prepare Mac inspection, saved-evidence reopening and report viewing.
Guide the participant through the published protocol and record only actual consented observations.
Use an existing explicitly approved Linux environment for Linux-only demo steps; otherwise record those steps as unperformed.
acceptance: Public artifact identity and actual environment recorded.
Participant's own patch review and negative-control diagnosis retained with consent.
Actual reopening/recovery and manual browser observations recorded with assistance and gaps.
No macOS demo support or human validation inferred from an agent run; partial work labeled PARTIAL.
